title: CoMT: A Novel Benchmark for Chain of Multi-modal Thought on Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (CoMT) focused on multi-modal reasoning tasks such as geometry, crowd counting, tangram recognition, and spot-the-difference. While it contains a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section in the appendix discussing data collection and participant recruitment, it does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
